claim: On the same 3,000 questions and same weights, M-ratio profiles across four domains are uncorrelated between Q5_K_M and f16 (Spearman rho = 0.00), while Type-2 AUROC profiles are perfectly rank-stable (rho = 1.00).
stance_target: Instrument/metric choice determines format sensitivity of confidence diagnostics
scope_conditions: Sec 4.1-4.2, Tables 3-4; one model, TriviaQA, four domains
quoted_support: M-ratio profiles across four knowledge domains are uncorrelated between formats (Spearman rho=0.00) ... Type-2 AUROC profiles are perfectly stable across formats (rho=1.00)

claim: Pre-registered confidence-amplification SFT doubled the Science NLP gap (0.076 to 0.152) but did not improve meta-d' (all four confirmatory hypotheses null), showing a first-moment confidence gap can rise without better discrimination structure.
stance_target: Confidence training effects need rank-based discrimination metrics
quoted_support: The training successfully reshaped confidence distributions, doubling the NLP gap in Science from 0.076 to 0.152, but did not improve meta-d'
